boundaries.start: Immediately before demo.run: token/digest preparation, Worker creation and JS load, WASM fetch/initialize, context creation and first rebuild included.
boundaries.end: Parent receives rendered after module evaluation and two iframe requestAnimationFrame callbacks, checks full revision token, swaps iframe and resolves build.
boundaries.excluded: npm install, development server startup, host asset prebuild, HTML navigation, demo helper JS and manifest fetch before demo.ready.
boundaries.warmup: No probe transform, no warmup bundle. Each of 3 samples has a fresh browser context and a fresh Worker; one Chrome process. Edit keeps the same esbuild context and browser HTTP cache.
boundaries.dependencyFixture: Public esm.sh React 19.3.0; actual network module fetches included in boot, no route mocks.
boundaries.cache: Local host assets served no-store. Public CDN responses may be cached on edit. OS/DNS/TLS/CDN/WASM compilation caches are not forcibly cleared.
boundaries.limitations: 2 rAF is a render proxy, not verified compositor paint. Tiny one-file fixture, 3 medians, not p95 or a reproduction of TOI 1.3 seconds.
